question.stem: \(a,a^2,a^3,\ldots\) is a geometric sequence with sum to infinity \(x\). Which range describes \(x\)?
question.stemZh: 等比數列 \(a,a^2,a^3,\ldots\) 的無窮和為 \(x\)。求 \(x\) 的範圍。
question.solution: Convergence requires \(-1<a<1\). Then \(x=a/(1-a)=1/(1-a)-1\). Since \(0<1-a<2\), \(x>-1/2\); every such x is achieved by \(a=x/(1+x)\).

question.stem: An arithmetic sequence has first term a and common difference d. If the sum of its first 10 terms is three times the sum of its first 5 terms, find a:d.

question.stem: The product of the first n terms of the geometric sequence \(1,2,2^2,2^3,\ldots\) is \(2^{406}\). Find n.
question.solution: Add exponents: \(0+1+\cdots+(n-1)=n(n-1)/2=406\). Thus \(n^2-n-812=0\), giving \(n=29\) or \(-28\). Reject the negative number of terms.

question.stem: In the figure, the first pattern has 3 dots. For every positive integer n, pattern \(n+1\) is formed by adding \(2n+1\) dots to pattern n. Find the number of dots in the seventh pattern.
question.stemZh: 如圖，第一個圖案有 3 點。對每個正整數 n，第 \(n+1\) 個圖案由第 n 個圖案加入 \(2n+1\) 點形成。求第七個圖案的點數。
question.solution: \(3+\sum_{n=1}^{6}(2n+1)=3+2(21)+6=51\). Only six additions are needed to reach pattern 7.

question.stem: The 12th term of an arithmetic sequence is ten times its 6th term. The sum of the first 10 terms is −5. Find the second term.
question.stemZh: 等差數列第 12 項是第 6 項的十倍，首 10 項之和為 −5。求第二項。

question.stem: Let \(a_n\) be the nth term of a GP of nonzero real numbers. Which are true? I. \(a_2,a_5,a_8,a_{11}\) form a GP. II. \(a_4^2=a_3a_5\). III. \(a_7/a_3>0\).
question.stemZh: 設 \(a_n\) 為非零實數等比數列的第 n 項。以下哪些正確？I. \(a_2,a_5,a_8,a_{11}\) 成等比。II. \(a_4^2=a_3a_5\)。III. \(a_7/a_3>0\)。
question.solution: Write \(a_n=ar^{n-1}\) with \(a\ne0,r\ne0\). I has ratio \(r^3\). II has both sides \(a^2r^6\). III equals \(r^4>0\), including negative r. All are true.
question.solutionZh: 寫成 \(a_n=ar^{n-1}\)，其中 a、r 均非零。I 的公比為 \(r^3\)；II 兩邊同為 \(a^2r^6\)；III 為 \(r^4>0\)，即使 r 負亦成立。三項皆正確。

question.stem: Wilson deposits $P on the first day of each year for 10 years at Green Bank, at 6% p.a. compounded quarterly. If the total interest at the end of year 10 is $10000, find P to the nearest integer.
question.stemZh: Wilson 連續 10 年於每年首日向 Green Bank 存入 $P，年利率 6%，按季複息。若第 10 年年底所得總利息為 $10000，求 P，答案取最接近整數。
question.solution: The deposits earn 40,36,...,4 quarters of interest. Let \(g=1.015^4\). Final value \(P\sum_{k=1}^{10}g^k=Pg(g^{10}-1)/(g-1)\). Deduct the total principal 10P: \(P[g(g^{10}-1)/(g-1)-10]=10000\). Thus \(P=2451.26750\ldots\) and the requested answer is $2451.

question.stem: A city spends \(\$3.24\times10^{10}\) on education in year 1 of a plan. Each subsequent year it spends 5% more. (a) Find total expenditure in the first 15 years. (b) Find the least integer n such that expenditure in the first n years exceeds \(\$10^{12}\).
question.stemZh: 某城市計劃第一年的教育開支為 \(\$3.24\times10^{10}\)，其後每年比前一年增加 5%。(a) 求首 15 年總開支。(b) 求最小整數 n，使首 n 年總開支超過 \(\$10^{12}\)。
question.solution: Use \(S_n=3.24\times10^{10}(1.05^n-1)/0.05\). (a) \(S_{15}\approx6.99145460258566\times10^{11}\) dollars, or \(6.99\times10^{11}\) to 3 significant figures. (b) \(1.05^n>206/81\) gives \(n>\log(206/81)/\log(1.05)\approx19.13146\). The least integer is 20; check n=19 and20 directly.

question.stem: Let A(n) be the nth term of an AP with \(A(3)=-14,A(10)=7\). (a) Find A(1). (b) Let \(G(n)=3^{A(n)}\) for positive integer n. Find the greatest integer k such that \(G(1)G(2)\cdots G(k)<100000\).
question.solution: (a) \(7d=21\) gives d=3 and \(A(1)=-14-2(3)=-20\). (b) Product \(=3^{S_k}\) with \(S_k=k(3k-43)/2\). Taking logarithms yields \(S_k<\log_3(100000)\). At k=14, \(S_{14}=-7\); at k=15, \(S_{15}=15\). From k=15 onward the sums increase, so the greatest k is 14.

question.stem: Boxes numbered 1,2,3,... contain numbers of one-dollar coins forming a GP. The third and fourth boxes contain 12 and24 coins. (a) Find the number in box 1. (b) Find the least n such that the total in boxes \(n,n+1,\ldots,2n\) exceeds $48960.
question.stemZh: 編號 1、2、3、… 的盒內各有若干一元硬幣，數量成等比數列。第 3、4 盒分別有 12、24 枚。(a) 求第 1 盒數量。(b) 求最小 n，使第 \(n,n+1,\ldots,2n\) 盒總金額超過 $48960。
question.solution: (a) \(r=24/12=2\) and \(a=12/2^2=3\). (b) The inclusive range has n+1 boxes: \(\sum_{k=n}^{2n}3\cdot2^{k-1}=3(2^{2n}-2^{n-1})\). Let t=2ⁿ. The condition becomes \((2t+255)(t-128)>0\). Since t>0, \(2^n>128\); the least n is8. At n=7 the sum equals48960.

(a) Find \(C_1D_1\). (b) Square \(B_2C_2D_2E_2\) is similarly inscribed in \(\triangle AB_1C_1\), with \(A,B_2,B_1\), \(A,C_2,C_1\) and \(B_1,E_2,D_2,C_1\) collinear. Find \(C_2D_2\). (c) Repeat to obtain a GP of square sides. Find (i) the common ratio; (ii) the sum to infinity of \(C_1D_1+C_2D_2+C_3D_3+\cdots\). Give rationalized surd answers.
question.stemZh: 如圖，ABC 是邊長為 2 的等邊三角形。內接正方形 \(B_1C_1D_1E_1\) 滿足 \(A,B_1,B\)、\(A,C_1,C\)、\(B,E_1,D_1,C\) 分別共線。(a) 求 \(C_1D_1\)。(b) 在 \(\triangle AB_1C_1\) 同樣內接正方形 \(B_2C_2D_2E_2\)，其中 \(A,B_2,B_1\)、\(A,C_2,C_1\)、\(B_1,E_2,D_2,C_1\) 分別共線，求 \(C_2D_2\)。(c) 持續相同過程，正方形邊長成等比數列，求 (i) 公比；(ii) 邊長無窮和。答案用根式表示並有理化。
question.solution: For an equilateral triangle of side L, inscribed square side s satisfies \(s=(L-s)\sin60^\circ\). Thus \(s/L=\sqrt3/(2+\sqrt3)=2\sqrt3-3\). (a) With L=2, \(s_1=4\sqrt3-6\). (b) The next triangle side is s₁, so \(s_2=s_1(2\sqrt3-3)=42-24\sqrt3\). (c)(i) \(r=2\sqrt3-3\) lies between0and1. (ii) \(S_\infty=(4\sqrt3-6)/(1-r)=\sqrt3\).
question.solutionZh: 設等邊三角形邊長 L、內接正方形邊長 s。由直角三角形得 \(s=(L-s)\sin60^\circ\)，故 \(s/L=2\sqrt3-3\)。(a) \(s_1=4\sqrt3-6\)。(b) 下一等邊三角形的邊長為 \(s_1\)，所以 \(s_2=42-24\sqrt3\)。(c)(i) 公比 \(2\sqrt3-3\)；(ii) 因其絕對值小於 1，無窮和 \((4\sqrt3-6)/(1-(2\sqrt3-3))=\sqrt3\)。

question.stem: Alex has a permanent full-time job paying $10000 per month in year1, increasing10% at the beginning of each subsequent year. He may either take a spare-time job earning an additional $3000 per month, or study a two-year master degree during spare time. After study his monthly full-time pay in year3 becomes $15000 and thereafter rises10% yearly; he takes no part-time job. Let \(P_n,F_n\) be his respective annual salaries under the part-time and study routes. (a) Express \(P_n\) in n. (b)(i) Find \(F_1,F_2\); (ii) express \(F_n\) for \(n\ge3\). Let \(A_m,B_m\) be total salaries over m years under the respective routes. (c) Show that \(A_m-B_m=12000[3m-29(1.1^{m-2}-1)]\) for \(m\ge3\). (d) Which route earns more if he retires at the end of year10?
question.stemZh: Alex 第一年的全職月薪為 $10000，其後每年年初加薪 10%。他可在工餘兼職，每月另賺 $3000；或在工餘修讀兩年碩士，完成後第三年的全職月薪為 $15000，其後每年仍加薪 10%，不再兼職。設 \(P_n,F_n\) 分別為兼職及進修方案第 n 年的年薪。(a) 以 n 表示 \(P_n\)。(b)(i) 求 \(F_1,F_2\)；(ii) 以 n 表示 \(n\ge3\) 時的 \(F_n\)。設 \(A_m,B_m\) 為兩方案首 m 年總薪金。(c) 證明 \(A_m-B_m=12000[3m-29(1.1^{m-2}-1)]\)，其中 \(m\ge3\)。(d) 若第 10 年年底退休，哪個方案總薪金較高？
question.solution: (a) \(P_n=120000(1.1)^{n-1}+36000\). (b) Study is during spare time: \(F_1=120000,F_2=132000\) and \(F_n=180000(1.1)^{n-3}\ (n\ge3)\). (c) \(A_m=1200000(1.1^m-1)+36000m\); \(B_m=252000+1800000(1.1^{m-2}-1)\). Subtract and use \(1.1^m=1.21(1.1^{m-2})\) to obtain the required identity. (d) \(A_{10}-B_{10}\approx-37968.91\), so study earns about $37968.91 more. No tuition cost is specified, so compare salaries only.
